about_the_game:
Welcome to Scholomatch, a magical dating game with a lot of heart and a little spice!

You're the newest student at the Horizon Wizarding Academy, an eclectic institution deep in the spirit realms. There you'll learn magic, meet fellow students, and uncover secrets that threaten the very foundation of the academy. Scholomatch is a game about dating sirens, werewolves, fairies, and a host of other wizarding students. Solve puzzles and build relationships as you explore the stories of deep, nuanced characters populating a rich world brimming with fantasy, wonder, and just a little spice.

  • Eleven main characters, each with their own art, voice, story, and gameplay mechanics.
  • Characters can be played through romantically or platonically, in any combination. Choices never block things off, so you can experience the 15+ hours of content in a single playthrough.
  • Match-3 gameplay with a magical twist as you learn spells from other students that unlock new gameplay possibilities.

content_descriptors.notes: Scholomatch contains non-explicit descriptions of sexual activity.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-4690K or AMD Ryzen 5 1500X
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 650 Ti, 2 GB or AMD Radeon R7 360, 2 GB or Intel Arc A380, 6 GB
  • Storage: 400 MB available space

reviews:
“[The] game with the distinction of having the most attractive artwork of any game I played at SIX this year. I discovered the world of the game, which takes place in a school of magic full to the brim with sexy and exuberant people. You’re able to romance whoever you want, but don’t expect these relationships to be one note.”
Hey Poor Player

“ScholoMatch is an unmatched visual novel in terms of design and inclusivity.”
Game Raven Review
short_description: Match gems, level up, and date wizards in this match-3 visual novel with a lot of heart and a little spice. Form deep relationships with faeries, sirens and werewolves, each with their own endearing personalities and challenges. Make choices that affect your relationships, and their destinies.
